From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-07T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: FW: Onboarding & PO question for short pilot

Folks — forwarding Horizon Lytics' ask. Pilot is small (estimated spend ~$9k over 30 days) but they'd like an invoice-only route for the first 90 days. Procurement typically requires a PO for onboarding > $5k, but we have an existing precedent for a temporary "staging invoice track" if we collect: 1) signed onboarding form, 2) MSA summary (or PoS), 3) finance authorization and a monthly spend cap, and 4) a billing contact on file.

Recommended approach:
- Marissa: propose we set them up on invoice-only pilot account with a $12k monthly cap and Net30.
- Priyom: need your sign-off on the exception guardrails (evidence checklist + who does the billing follow-up).

If approved, I'll respond to Samantha with the required evidence checklist and a DocuSign link for the onboarding form.

Thanks,
Markus
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@horizonlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-08T10:25:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding & PO question for short pilot

Hi Samantha — great to hear the team is ready. We can make a temporary exception and route Horizon Lytics on an invoice-only pilot account while your PO is being processed, subject to the following guardrails (standard internal exception):

1) Signed onboarding form (attached DocuSign) and a redwood-signed MSA summary on file.
2) Billing cap: $12,000/month for the first 90 days. If you exceed 85% of the cap we pause usage and request PO or prepay.
3) Net30 payment terms for pilot invoices.
4) Primary billing contact and remit-to email (please confirm).
5) Finance will run a one-time credit check for final authorization.

I've attached the onboarding checklist and a draft SOW for reference. If this works, please complete the onboarding form via this secure link: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc-123 and reply with the completed PDF and billing contact. We'll then activate the pilot account and route invoices to procure@horizonlytics.com.

Note: This is a temporary routing policy — once your PO is available we will migrate you to standard PO-based onboarding and reconcile any invoices.

Best regards,
Markus Klein
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: SOW_Draft.docx (22 KB)]
